entry.title: dragon-agents 1.3.0: Every agent now closes every dispatch with a structured debug report, and the dispatcher files actionable findings as GitHub issues in this repo.

dragon-agents 1.1.0: Twenty-ninth agent: **imprint**, the GitHub-metadata seat (Brandon's request).

dragon-agents 1.0.0: The first drop of purpose-built write agents (Brandon's request; the web-researcher watch-list condition fired): two new write seats under purpose-built fences, roster twenty-eight.

hex 0.23.0: The money kit, from the economy-doc mining: the currency tables pinned verbatim, the purse line parsed, and the documented money commands one alias away.
hex 0.22.0: Phase 5's offline remainder: the travel annotations, in the shape the data actually supports.

hex 0.21.0: Phase 4's offline remainder plus the safety kit the combat-doc mining earned: every line shape in this release is pinned verbatim in the doc mirror, so it all works today, and every send stays behind a user alias.
hex 0.20.0: The Phase 1 and Phase 2 finishers: the last unticked box of the 1.x lane and two of Phase 2's leftovers, all offline work the pinned docs and the existing graph already supported.

hex 0.19.0: The hunt-and-death awareness release, built straight out of Brandon's own logs: the sweep that mined his session transcripts found the death we thought was uncapturable, the first two consider shapes, the whole corpse family, and one crash that had never been hit yet.
hex 0.18.1: A one-line crash fix, found in Brandon's own session logs by the utilization sweep: the MDT people tracker crashed mid-walk on a writtenmap naming a nationality'd carriage driver.

hex 0.18.0: The situational-awareness release: a new family of read-only investigation commands (`hex_scry`) built from the week's actual failure modes: night walks, locked gates, dark rooms, disconnected parcel destinations, and the corpse walk.
Viaduct 4.4.2: link-looking titles can't forge feeds

hex 0.17.2: The night-walk fix, for real this time: dark rooms push room.info WITHOUT the identifier field (you cannot identify a room you cannot see), and the walker was ignoring exactly those pushes, so a 38-step walk through dark countryside counted "step 0/38" the entire way while successfully moving Brandon every step.
hex 0.17.1: Two small fixes from live use of the item commands:

hex 0.17.0: Found live, twice in one night: `/goto` happily routes through climb-window shortcuts (the guild dorm wings connect to the ground floor over the rooftops), and an untrained level-4 student who follows one at spindlewinter night ends up stranded on a ledge with `[none]` exits, a burnt torch, and a full queue of "What?".
hex 0.16.1: Two walker bugs from the first live night walk (a 32-step route over the guild rooftops, in the dark, on spindlewinter night; Brandon's Hex life is hard):
hex 0.16.0: The chat capture finally met a real talker: Brandon joined the Conlegium Sicariorum and its wooden bracelet started chattering.

hex 0.15.0: Brandon joined the Assassins' Guild on the wire (the captured sequence: application form from the black box in the foyer, south to the secretary, `say apply`), and the score-verbose clause confirmed it: "you are level 3 in the Assassins' Guild".
hex 0.14.1: Hotfix, same evening: `/goto #1` crashed with "attempt to index a nil value (global 'deps')".

hex 0.14.0: The big one, found the moment Brandon first stood somewhere real and typed `/goto foyer`: **`/goto` had never actually worked.** Every route call received the current room's 40-hex identifier (straight from GMCP via `need_start`), and the pathfinder indexed its graph by vnum only, so the Dijkstra never started, `/goto` printed its candidate list with every entry "unreachable", and no walk ever launched.

hex 0.13.1: A live-found fix from Brandon's first walk in Ankh-Morpork: `/near market` from God Street listed five unreachable strangers in Genua and Ephebe while AM's own Job Market rooms never appeared.
hex 0.13.0: Phase 8's core engineering piece: the fake-GMCP harness. The dead-vitals bug class is now a red CI run instead of a dead status bar at login.
hex 0.12.2-dbg: The debug lane's mobile phase: Brandon is out in the real world, so the verification commands grow legs.

hex 0.12.1-dbg: A debug release in the v0.5.2-dbg tradition: the capture lane comes back for one specific verification pass (the combat-monitor parse has never seen a real wire line), and `/doctor` ships as the new permanent fixture.

hex 0.12.0: The golden engine's fourth layer: route goldens, committed at last now that the licensing call is settled (rooms.db derives from tt_dw's public-domain map, so the fixtures are clean to commit; Brandon confirmed).
